# EXP Bank Calculator developer docs

> Documentation for integrating with the public EXP Bank Calculator resources.

## When to use these docs

Use these docs when an agent needs endpoint schemas, example requests,
authentication information, or the limits of the static GitHub Pages
deployment.

## Start here

- [HTML API docs](https://torturado.github.io/docs)
- [Markdown API docs](https://torturado.github.io/docs.md)
- [OpenAPI 3.1 specification](https://torturado.github.io/openapi.json)
- [Authentication](https://torturado.github.io/auth.md)
- [API section guide](https://torturado.github.io/api/llms.txt)
